clips.title: The story
paras: In the northeastern Barrens, the Venture Company tears into Boulder Lode Mine for its riches. Orcish banners and watchtowers mark a claim the Horde once held.

Weathered orcish works frame the mine mouth, signs that the Horde once held or founded the claim. Now Venture Company overseers and enforcers answer to Boss Copperplug. The goblin syndicate strips the canyon for minerals, gems, and machinery, with little care for the land or its workers.

Riches from the mine have drawn attention from Ratchet. Wharfmaster Dizzywig has sent mercenaries after a rumored massive emerald found in the tunnels. Engineers seeking to understand goblin machinery also know that Boss Copperplug keeps key operating manuals in his camp.
